name: haiku-100k
description: Keeps every Haiku request under the 100k-token price step: a haiku-case agent that compacts at 100k, a /haiku-100k:setup command for main Haiku sessions, a hook that cuts oversized tool results and flags any request over 100k, the haiku-build skill (v2, seven stages: Opus plans, Haiku implements and tests on a retry ladder, Sonnet reviews, a script sets the final status), haiku-build-auto (the same flow unattended: no questions, one terminal status done / done_with_findings / blocked), the subagent-model-router skill (picks haiku / sonnet / opus per subagent; not registered by default), and agent-reliability (stops unproductive test/build retry loops, Opus recovery escalation; observe mode by default, /reliability, AGENT_RELIABILITY=off), and effort-pace (per-step effort for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus: low on routine read steps, TypeSafe Jev picks it on pivot steps of Haiku/Sonnet, Opus is capped at medium and never raised to high; stops Bash calls that would hold a turn for minutes, every model; /effort-pace, EFFORT_PACE=off; /haiku-pace still works).

paceMode.title: Pace: Mode
paceMode.description: Per-step effort for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus requests. apply: send the chosen effort; shadow: log it only; off: no effort change, the long-command guard stays on. Env EFFORT_PACE and /effort-pace override it; EFFORT_PACE=off disables the whole mod.

paceOpus.title: Pace: Opus too
paceOpus.description: Pace Opus steps between low and medium: routine read steps low, turn start / after a failure / after a big edit medium, other steps at most medium; a session at xhigh/max is left alone. Off: Opus keeps the session's effort.

paceJev.title: Pace: Ask TypeSafe Jev on pivot steps
paceJev.description: Turn start, after a failure, after a big edit: Jev picks low / medium / high (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, costs per call). Off or unsure: high.

paceJevBudget.title: Pace: Jev calls per session
paceJevBudget.description: Past this, pivot steps take the fallback (high) without asking.

paceJevTimeoutMs.title: Pace: Jev timeout (ms)
paceJevTimeoutMs.description: On timeout the pivot step takes the fallback (high).

paceJevMinConfidence.title: Pace: Jev min probability
paceJevMinConfidence.description: Jev's level is used only at or above this probability.

paceBigEditLines.title: Pace: Big edit (lines)
paceBigEditLines.description: An Edit/Write of at least this many lines makes the next step a pivot (it verifies the change).

mode.title: Reliability: Mode
mode.description: observe (log only), enforce (deny), or off. Env AGENT_RELIABILITY and /reliability override it.

ruleB.title: Reliability: Rule B: block identical repeats
ruleB.description: In enforce mode, deny a repeat of a verification that failed the same way with nothing changed.

ruleA.title: Reliability: Rule A: recovery budget + Opus escalation
ruleA.description: In enforce mode, deny the next verification after maxRecoveryStrategies failed attempts and ask for the Opus recovery agent; then NEEDS_USER. Off: logged only.

maxRecoveryStrategies.title: Reliability: Recovery strategies before escalation
maxRecoveryStrategies.description: Failed reruns that followed a change (edit, mutating command) on one incident.

maxIdenticalFailuresBeforeBlock.title: Reliability: Identical failures before block
maxIdenticalFailuresBeforeBlock.description: Same action + same error + no change, this many times, then the next repeat is blocked.

failureRecordTtlMinutes.title: Reliability: Record TTL (minutes)
failureRecordTtlMinutes.description: Older failures and incidents never block.

maxRecordsPerSession.title: Reliability: Max records
maxRecordsPerSession.description: Bound on failure records kept per session.

gitTimeoutMs.title: Reliability: Git state budget (ms)
gitTimeoutMs.description: Total time for the git content token; over budget = unknown = allow.

telemetry.title: Reliability: Telemetry
telemetry.description: JSONL decisions to <telemetry folder>/<session>.jsonl (no tool output).

telemetryDir.title: Reliability: Telemetry folder
telemetryDir.description: Absolute folder for the JSONL files. Empty = telemetry/ inside this plugin's own folder.

dumpRaw.title: Reliability: Diagnostics dump
dumpRaw.description: Phase 0 only: filtered result fields to diag-<session>.jsonl. Leave off.

jevEnabled.title: Reliability: Ask JEV on near-duplicates
jevEnabled.description: Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY; errors and timeouts allow.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Reliability: JEV timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: Decision budget; on timeout the call is allowed.

jevMinConfidence.title: Reliability: JEV min confidence
jevMinConfidence.description: block_redundant_retry must reach this probability to block.

mainAgentOnly.title: Reliability: Main agent only
mainAgentOnly.description: Leave subagent verification calls alone (subagents are tracked separately when off).

extraEligible.title: Reliability: Extra eligible commands
extraEligible.description: Comma-separated command prefixes treated as tests.

ruleC.title: Reliability: Rule C: refusal loops
ruleC.description: In enforce mode, deny resending a call the harness refused, and any retry of an action the user denied (by another tool, shell or path) until /reliability allow lifts it.

jevAdvisor.title: Reliability: Jev Recovery Advisor
jevAdvisor.description: off: no call. shadow: from the 2nd consecutive failure, ask TypeSafe Jev for one of 5 recovery actions and log it only. apply (enforce mode): carry the decision out inside the core limits. shadow/apply send a redacted incident summary (commands, short error text, no file contents) to TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter (needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY) and cost money per call.

jevAdvisorMinConfidence.title: Reliability: Jev advisor min probability
jevAdvisorMinConfidence.description: next_step must reach this probability to be applied; below it the v0.2 behaviour stays.

includePromptInJev.title: Reliability: Send the user prompt to Jev
includePromptInJev.description: Adds the last user prompt (redacted, 300 chars) to the advisor request. Off by default.

datasetCapture.title: Reliability: Local failure dataset
datasetCapture.description: One sanitized line per failed attempt, refusal, Jev decision and incident end to attempts-YYYY-MM.jsonl (no tool output, no file contents, no prompt). Local only.

datasetDir.title: Reliability: Dataset folder
datasetDir.description: Absolute folder for attempts-YYYY-MM.jsonl. Empty = ~/.claude/agent-reliability/dataset (outside the plugin and the repo).
